source.detail: Enrichments.recurrence removed; prism nullable; investments responses use InvestmentAccount

spec_evidence.checked: Official plaid-node CHANGELOG.md 42.0.0 breaking list verified: the deprecated beta recurrence field (plus Recurrence/RecurringFrequency schemas) was removed from /transactions/enrich responses; CraPartnerInsightsPrism became nullable and prism is omitted when Prism Data was not requested; investments responses now use InvestmentAccount, a widening of AccountBase that adds margin_loan_amount without removing fields.

fix.migration_guide: Two mechanical edits: (1) delete reads of enrichments.recurrence and any imports of the removed Recurrence/RecurringFrequency types - the upstream data product was discontinued with no successor field, so removal is the safe codemod; (2) add a null guard (optional chaining or explicit check) around partner-insights prism access, since the field is now omitted when Prism Data was not requested. The InvestmentAccount change is additive widening and needs no consumer edit.
fix.example_before:
const freq = enrichment.recurrence.frequency;
const score = insights.prism.cash_score;
fix.example_after:
// recurrence removed upstream (product discontinued)
const score = insights.prism?.cash_score ?? null;
